title: cylindropuntia californica subsp. parkeri
intro: Cylindropuntia californica subsp. parkeri, commonly known as the California prickly pear or "Park's prickly pear," is a species of cactus native to the southwestern United States. It is a type of cactus used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including wound healing, inflammation reduction, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Cylindropuntia californica subsp. parkeri have also been shown to possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
